import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check for websocket-related log entries
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -i 'ws\\|websocket\\|connection' /tmp/server.log | tail -20")
print("WS log:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
